body:
A play that asks a person a question must follow the shared rule `core/components/memory/standards/rules/asking-a-person.md` (#820). Today nothing checks this. A play can ask questions in its own way, and nobody sees it until a person rejects a checkpoint.

## What to build

A check in the component linter. It fails a play when the play asks a person a question (it has a checkpoint, or it shows questions for a typed answer) and its SKILL.md does not point to `asking-a-person.md`.

## Done when

- The linter fails a play that asks a person and does not point to the rule.
- The linter passes edit-ontology and author-product-ontology (they point to the rule).
- A test shows both cases.
- The linter's error count on main goes up by no more than the plays it now names, and those are listed in the PR.

Parent: #794. Follows #820.

comments.body: Add to this issue (from the review of PR #823): the edit-ontology play and the author-product-ontology skill name `standards/rules/asking-a-person.md` by path, but no step tells product-os-keeper to load it through the memory tool and give it to the skill (ADR 039 §2, ADR 009 Rule 3). So today the pointer does nothing. Done when also: the play's Step 1/3/5 contracts hand the rule to the agent, and the agent passes it to the skill. Also say it once (Step 1), not four times.

title: Lint: a play that asks a person must point to the asking-a-person rule
